title: Colony and Machine
author: August Ravensworth
blurb: Mara Eriksen, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
